title: Payroll Administrator
description:
TPF Recruitment is delighted to be representing one of our established clients based in Eastleigh, Hampshire, in their search for a Payroll Administrator. This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing business and develop your payroll career within a supportive team environment.

Our client provides tailored payroll services to businesses of all sizes across the UK, offering a personalised approach to meet the individual needs of each client.

As a Payroll Administrator, you will support the delivery of accurate and efficient payroll services across a varied client portfolio. Working closely with experienced colleagues, you will assist with processing weekly, fortnightly and monthly payrolls, responding to client queries and ensuring payroll deadlines are consistently met.

The business is currently experiencing an exciting period of growth, offering the successful candidate the opportunity to develop their skills and progress their career over time.

Key Responsibilities
- Process weekly, fortnightly and monthly payrolls for a diverse portfolio of clients.
- Collate and input payroll information, ensuring data is accurate and processed within the required deadlines.
- Assist with payroll reconciliations and the preparation of payroll reports.
- Support the administration of pension auto-enrolment and related submissions.
- Respond to client, HMRC and internal payroll queries in a professional and timely manner.
- Assist with the calculation of statutory payments, including SSP and statutory family leave.
- Maintain accurate payroll records and ensure relevant documentation is kept up to date.
- Support the onboarding of new clients and the setup of payroll systems.
- Work collaboratively with the wider payroll team to ensure a high standard of service.

Requirements
- Previous experience in payroll administration, ideally within an accountancy practice or payroll bureau environment.
- A good understanding of payroll processes, including PAYE, National Insurance and workplace pensions.
- Familiarity with statutory payments, including SSP and statutory family leave, would be advantageous.
- Strong numerical skills and excellent attention to detail.
- Good organisational skills, with the ability to manage workloads and meet deadlines.
- Confident communication skills, with a professional and client-focused approach.
- Competent IT skills, including Microsoft Office and Excel.
- A proactive attitude and willingness to learn and develop within a growing team.

Benefits
- Salary of £26,000 - £30,000 per annum, depending on experience.
- 25 days' annual leave plus bank holidays.
- Hybrid working opportunities.
- Flexible start and finish times.
- Exposure to a varied portfolio of clients across the UK.
- Opportunities for ongoing training, development and career progression.

title: Business Administration Apprentice
description:
Business Administration Apprentice - Eastleigh 23,500 Full-Time - Office based

Are you leaving school or college and looking to start your career in a professional office environment where you can learn key skills for the future?

We are seeking a motivated Business Administration Apprentice to join a successful electrical and mechanical services business in the Eastleigh area. This is an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience while working towards a recognised qualification, and the development opportunities are fantastic.

Duties include
- Providing general administrative support to the office team
- Help prepare and format documents, letters, and administrative paperwork
- Support record-keeping for quotes, job details, and job documentation
- Answering calls and responding to emails
- Assist with updating calendars for site visits, meetings, and appointments.
- Updating company records and spreadsheets
- Filing, scanning and preparing project documentation
- Supporting the smooth day-to-day running of the business

Training & Development
- Attend college one day per week as part of your apprenticeship
- Receive full training and support from an experienced team
- Learn to use AutoCAD and develop technical drawing skills
- Build valuable administrative, IT and business skills

What We're Looking For
- Positive attitude and willingness to learn
- Strong organisational and communication skills
- Basic IT skills, including Microsoft Office
- A reliable and professional approach

Please be aware this advert will remain open until the vacancy has been filled. Interviews will take place throughout this period, therefore we encourage you to apply early to avoid disappointment.

Tate is acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy.

Tate is committed to promoting equal opportunities. To ensure that every candidate has the best experience with us, we encourage you to let us know if there are any adjustments we can make during the application or interview process. Your comfort and accessibility are our priority, and we are here to support you every step of the way. Additionally, we value and respect your individuality, and we invite you to share your preferred pronouns in your application.

title: Complaints Handler
description:
Complaints Handler
Location: Eastleigh - Hybrid working 2 days from home after a training period
Salary: £17 p/h
Hours of work: 37 hours per week - 8.30 AM to 5 PM

This is a temporary role for 12 weeks, with potential opportunities to remain with the organisation.
Dynamite Recruitment is delighted to be working in partnership with a very well-established and fast-growing organisation based in Eastleigh.
Our client is looking to recruit Complaints Handler/Customer Relations Officers to join their busy team.

As a Complaints Handler/Customer Relations Officer you will be responsible for:
- Work as part of a specialist complaints department to deal with customers who have a complaint to make or who are disgruntled with the service that they have been provided with
- Respond and resolve customer complaints and escalations.
- Liaise with internal departments and third parties to manage the enquiry with professionalism.
- To provide a solution to customers within satisfactory timescales
- Ensure that feedback is provided to the appropriate Line Manager regarding the outcome of a complaint.
- Follow up with the customer if necessary and to ensure that a bad situation is turned into a positive one.
- To respond to customers' needs in person and via email.

The Ideal Complaints Handler will have/be:
- Must be able to start on 9th November.
- Demonstrable experience of Complaints & Resolution / have worked within a customer service role where you have managed challenging situations.
- You must have had complaints experience where they have had to write formal letter responses.
- Excellent English skills with strong letter writing skills.
- Confident, and if necessary, authoritative on the phone.
- Strong interpersonal and influencing skills.
- Ability to prioritise workload.
- Work independently as well as part of a team.
- Strong customer service and telephone skills.
- Good negotiating skills.

To be considered please submit your CV asap.

title: Project Administrator
description:

Salary: £25,800
Job Type: Full-time, permanent
Hours: Mon to Fri, 8am - 4pm or 9am - 5pm (37.5 hours per week)
Interview & Start Date

- Process supplier orders promptly to support timely payments.
- Manage customer queries and complaints, escalating issues where required
- Support the reporting and resolution of Health & Safety issues and emergencies
- Ensure compliance with company policies and promote best practices across daily operations
